description: Start or reuse one school's policy: its institution-wide rules, worked out once and used by every playlist at that school. Finds the school's captured pages that carry institution-wide rules, then answers hit (the stored policy, its policy_id, status and trust_state), or stale or miss with a manifest of sections to read with playlist_read: award_types, policies, one page:<capture_file> for each qualifying page, and designations, each with its character count. On stale it also returns the stored policy, so you can see what changed. The server calls no AI model: you read the sections, reason over them yourself, and send the policy with playlist_policy_save. On stale or miss the answer also carries procedure, a numbered list of steps that is the same for every caller, and procedure_version: follow the steps in their order; area_lines, the area names the school's checklists use, each a query for playlist_find_pages; and award_titles, the award titles the school's programs use: a policy gives an award rule for each award title and a designation for each area line where the school's pages state one. Pass rebuild true to build a held policy again: a hit then carries the sections, the next step and the procedure as well, and the policy in use is replaced only when a new one passes its save. Where the publish's academic policy index is held, the answer also carries policy_index: the school's index rows (kind, scope, department, program_id, title, source_url, quote), and with checklist_id the rows scoped to that checklist's program and to its college or department. No row is a ruling: a quote is evidence you cite exactly as printed, read from its page.

checklist_id.description: Optional: a checklist at this school; the policy index rows scoped to its program and to its college or department are listed beside the school's

rebuild.description: Optional: true to get the sections to read though a policy is held, so the policy can be built again

unitid.description: The school, by its IPEDS UNITID
